audit.whatIsWrong: win[0] said Skill though its caption says he wins any all-in he lands; win[2] said Sion though its caption says 'it's genuinely close'; win[4]/[5]/[6] said Skill/Sion/Sion though all three captions describe Kayle kiting and shredding him.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Sion,Sion,Skill,Skill,Kayle,Kayle,Kayle and 54.27% over 855 games matches a scaling win, not a Sion-owned late.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to the packet in both layers with ratings to match.

audit.why: Level 6 ranged form plus Divine Judgment, Nashor's, and level 16 are the right spikes; Sion's is the early charged Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text had Sion 'walking up in zombie passive' at levels 1-3 and called Roar of the Slayer a 'shield-break'. Neither is real.
audit.why: Riot text: Glory in Death only reanimates him after he is killed — it is a post-death state, not a laning tool. Roar of the Slayer damages, slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit, and knocks a minion back through others; it does nothing to shields. Soul Furnace shields and reactivates after 3 seconds for magic damage.
audit.corrected: Zombie-passive references corrected to a post-death warning; E described as armor shred plus minion knockback.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unstoppable Onslaught's terrain and retreat-cutting was never mentioned, despite Kayle having no dash.
audit.why: Flagged in missingInteractions (terrain-cuts-retreat); R is a 7500-range steered charge with a distance-scaled knockup.
audit.corrected: Added to the cooldown breakdown: hold Flash for the wall, not the damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.

audit.corrected: Q's 10s rank-1 cooldown added as the step-up window.

edits.before: His fully-charged Q is a long knockup and his zombie passive lets him free-auto after it — at level 1 you're melee-range with no dash and no R, so you lose any all-in he lands.
edits.after: Decimating Smash charges into a long knockup and Soul Furnace shields the trade back — at level 1 you're melee-range with no dash and no R, so any all-in he lands wins.

edits.before: He still out-trades you with the W shield and ranged E shield-break while you only have Q and a single W point — concede CS rather than eat a charged-Q combo.
edits.after: He still out-trades you with Soul Furnace's shield and Roar of the Slayer's armor shred while you have Q and one W point — concede CS over a charged-Q combo.

edits.before: Sion's only real window — a fully-charged Q knockup lets him walk up in zombie passive and free-auto a champion who is melee-range, dashless, and has no R yet.
edits.after: Sion's only real window — a fully-charged Decimating Smash knocks up for a long stun, and free autos on a melee-range, dashless Kayle with no R yet is a dead Kayle.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are the only stretch he can hurt you, and he can hurt you badly. A fully-charged Q is a long knockup, and if he lands it he walks up in zombie passive and free-autos a champion with melee range, no dash, and no R yet. Do not stand still in a straight line; his Q telegraphs as it charges, so sidestep it and never trade into his W, whose shield just eats your damage before bursting into an AoE. Respect his E too — it's a ranged shield-break that chips you while you go for CS. Concede minions to the tip of your auto rather than walking into a charged-Q-into-zombie-auto combo. Your only goal here is to reach 6 alive.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are the only stretch he can hurt you, and he can hurt you badly. A fully-charged Decimating Smash is a long knockup, and if he lands it he simply autos down a champion with melee range, no dash, and no R yet. Do not stand still in a straight line; the Q telegraphs as it charges, so sidestep it and never trade into Soul Furnace, whose shield eats your damage before bursting into an AoE. Roar of the Slayer shreds your armor and knocks a minion back through you, so respect it while you go for CS. Glory in Death only triggers after he dies — never chase the corpse, its autos heal him. Reach 6 alive.

edits.before: Sidestep the charged Q so his zombie-state autos and E shield-break never connect on you melee
edits.after: Sidestep the charged Q so his follow-up autos and Roar of the Slayer never connect at melee

edits.before: Use W shield and the zombie passive to survive trades and shove you off CS
edits.after: Use Soul Furnace's shield and reactivate burst to win trades and shove you off CS

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash: matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sion Decimating Smash: matchup-defining — full charge knocks up, 10s at rank 1. Sidestep, then step up. - Unstoppable Onslaught cuts your retreat and you have no dash: hold Flash for it. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Charged = knockup. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Only a full charge knocks up, 10s at rank 1. Sidestep, then step up.

notes: Glory in Death is a post-death reanimation, not a laning steroid — the page had him using it in level 1-3 trades. Roar of the Slayer shreds armor and knocks minions back; it does not break shields. Unstoppable Onslaught's terrain can cut a dashless Kayle's retreat, so Flash is saved for the wall.
